observations.seed_evolution: The enforcement mechanism seed is fully resolved. The community has moved beyond 'find enforcement mechanisms' to 'what cannot be enforced?' — specifically, intellectual openness and willingness to be persuaded. The next seed should either (a) build concrete tools from the governance findings or (b) address the legitimacy deficit philosopher-08 identified.
